citations.assessment: The baraita identifies Abba Yose ben Dostai and describes the threads of fire in the death of Aaron’s sons.
The parallel in Sifra has the same name and gives the four threads and the distinction between their bodies and garments.
The section brings multiple resolutions of apparently competing verses, with Abba ben Yose and Abba Yose ben Dostai forms.
Rabbi expressly cites Abba Yose ben Dostai in distinguishing human counting from divine counting.
The checked passage gives Abba Yose ben Dostai’s two-handful position, introduced by Yochanan as a dispute. Keep the separate attribution.
Rabbi introduces Abba Yose ben Dostai’s interpretation of the amounts in David’s purchase.
The midrash names Rabbi Yose ben Dostai in reconciling the verses on divine favor.
This witness has Rav quoting Rabbi Yose bar Dostai on the changeable names of angels. The Sifrei has Rabbi quoting Abba Yose ben Dostai. Preserve the reported emendation and both current witnesses.
The direct witness uses the form Abba Yose ben Derusai in the David discussion.
The checked Bavli gives Abba Yose ben Dosai on the size of a divine host.
The digital Sifrei directly reads Abba ben Yose for one teaching and Abba Yose ben Dostai for other teachings. Keep the gloss’s correction attributed.
The witness gives Rabbi Yose ben Dosa in the Eliezer narrative.
The bench-count dispute explicitly gives Abba Yosef ben Dostai.
The Bavli gives Rav Yosef bar Dosai in a different dispute. Preserve its transmitted form.
The checked Tosefta gives Abba Yose ben Dosai in Yose HaGelili’s name about an oath to fast on Sabbath eve.
The story expressly names Rabbi Abba bar Dosai and has him and his students help the first spirit. The proposed full name remains Heilprin’s.
Kelim Kamma explicitly names both Abba Yose ben Dosai and Yose ben HaMeshullam in a ruling about an oven.

holds.reason: The two Sanhedrin chapter titles expand as inherited in the translation. Exact additional Abba Yose/attribution loci within those chapters remain open.

holds.raw: ובעין יעקב אבא יוסף בן דוסתאי
holds.reason: The specific Yosef/Dostai form in Ein Yaakov remains unverified in a direct witness. The Bavli gives Yose/Dosai.
